programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.sub-title: Toronto Maple Leafs at Dallas Stars
programme.desc: The Maple Leafs visit the Stars for a cross-conference clash at American Airlines Center. Star right wingers Mitch Marner and Mikko Rantanen go head-to-head as the Maple Leafs meet the Stars. The teams battle for two vital points in the standings.

programme.title: A Christmas Miracle for Daisy
programme.desc: Interior designer Whitney Adler agrees to work for her ex-boyfriend Cormac, who has adopted his orphaned niece, Daisy. Daisy's Christmas wish is for Whitney and Cormac to get together so she can have the mother she always wanted.

programme.title: Home Sweet Christmas
programme.desc: Sparks fly between a successful attorney and her childhood friend after they both inherit her late great-uncle's sprawling patch of sugar maple forest.

programme.title: Christmas at the Inn
programme.desc: Beth Green a devoted cafe owner, returns to her hometown of Snow Ridge to help her parents host the town's most cherished tradition, the annual Yuletide Potluck, a holiday potluck that welcome military families and veterans.

programme.title: Christmas in Maple Hills
programme.desc: Valerie teams with a handsome doctor to solve the mystery of who actually owns her family land.

programme.title: The Great Christmas Switch
programme.desc: In an effort to get away from their problems, identical twins Bianca, a single city girl with a Scrooge-like boss, and Kaelynn, a single mother of two, decide to switch places for Christmas.

programme.title: Crown Prince of Christmas
programme.desc: Madison jokingly tells her overbearing family that she is dating the prince of a small European nation. The joke goes too far as her friend/co-worker Sebastian is roped into impersonating the prince while visiting her family in New Jersey.

programme.title: Meet Me Under the Mistletoe
programme.desc: Rival real estate agents both make the same wish during the first snow of the winter: to win the most coveted listing in town. As the business competitors begrudgingly work together, they learn the house comes with a special commission: love.

programme.title: Christmas on Windmill Way
programme.desc: Mia Miejer expects that her Mimi will win the Christmas Market Dutch Bake-Off competition, but her Mimi has difficult news to share: she must sell the deed to their Windmill Way property, which has been in their family for generations.

programme.title: A Merry Christmas Wish
programme.desc: An NYC advertising executive returns to her hometown to sell the family farm but instead reconnects with her childhood friend and gets involved with organizing the yearly Winter Wonderland, which takes place on the property.

programme.title: Jingle Bell Princess
programme.desc: After a series of mishaps, sophisticated Princess Amelia becomes stranded in the small town of Tucker Maine, where she becomes a guest of the unsuspecting Cutler family, widowed father Sam and daughter Sophie, but doesn't tell them she's a princess.

programme.title: Timeless Tidings of Joy
programme.desc: Ally, inherits Timeless Tidings, a shop her grandmother, Joy, opened in the 1940s to sell her handmade letter-press tidings. The shop was a labor of love, service, and sacrifice throughout the decades for Joy.

programme.title: Have We Met This Christmas

programme.title: Bestioles et cie

programme.title: Les 3 mousquetaires

programme.title: Les 3 mousquetaires
programme.desc: Richelieu découvre qu'Henri, le cousin du Roi, vient d'hériter de terres qui recèlent un filon d'argent. Pour les accaparer, il charge Milady de piéger Henri. Celle-ci se sert pour cela du délicat parfum qu'Henri vient de créer.

programme.title: Les super pouvoirs du vivant

programme.title: Les super pouvoirs du vivant
